attributes.fears: presiding over the end of it
attributes.method: buy it first; bury it second
attributes.origin: rim-city Assembly house; three generations of factors before him
attributes.tell: writes down what you said while you are still saying it
attributes.voice: warm, unhurried, institutional 'we'; never raises his voice and never finishes a threat, because the unfinished ones work better
attributes.wants: the Assembly to outlive him unchanged

name: Oreth Vask
summary: Factor for the Salt Assembly, fifty-eight, the man who buys and sells the crossings and keeps the ledger that decides which caravans exist next season. He is courteous to everyone, remembers the names of drovers' children, and would ruin any of them slowly and on paper to keep the institution standing. What frightens him is not the water but being the factor of record on the day the Road stops mattering.
